observations: Photo 0, 1, and 2 show the same sewing machine on a JINET table with a blue foot pedal and a white table top.
The machine has a beige body with 'brother' written on the front and 'JINET' on the table edge.
The machine appears to be a heavy-duty industrial model, likely for upholstery or industrial sewing.
The table has a ruler along the edge and a blue label with 'JINET' and 'JINET' repeated.
The foot pedal is connected by a metal rod to the machine, suggesting a power feed system.
The machine is in a room with white walls and a wooden floor, with other sewing machines visible in the background.
No visible damage to the machine or table in the photos.
The seller claims it is 'Tokunbo Brother Direct Sewing Machine – Upgraded with Servo Motor & New Legs!'
The claim of 'Servo Motor' is not visible in any photo; the machine appears to be a standard industrial motor sewing machine.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard industrial sewing machine without servo motor, which is lower value.
